Draft/Notes
To: [Vendor contact email]
Subject: Follow-up: Delayed shipment for PO #[PO#] — Requesting updated ETA & tracking

Hello [Name],

I’m following up on shipment for PO #[PO#]. We expected delivery on [original ETA], but we haven’t received an updated ETA or tracking.

Please confirm as soon as possible:
- Current shipment status and reason for the delay
- New estimated ship and delivery dates
- Carrier and tracking number (or proof of shipment)
- Any actions needed from our side to help expedite

Please respond by end of business Monday so we can adjust plans accordingly. If you cannot meet that timeline, please escalate to your manager and include their contact.

Thanks,
[Your name]
[Company]
[Phone/email]

Limitations and next steps
I can’t send or schedule emails or send a ping when it’s sent. To send this Monday at 8:00 their local time, schedule the message in your email client (Gmail: Send arrow → “Schedule send”; Outlook: “Delay Delivery” / “Schedule Send”). To get notified once it goes, set a calendar reminder or task that triggers at the scheduled send time.
